subject: Mutual Action Plan — Velora Health pilot & production rollout
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (pilot success criteria & timeline)

Hi Emily — great call earlier today, thanks for walking through the pilot goals. Per our discussion attached is the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft v3 with milestones, owners, and dependencies. High level recap: 

- Pilot scope: 1 external API integration (appointment reminders) + seed dataset for 3 provider locations
- Success criteria: 95% webhook delivery within SLA, false positive rate <2% on intent classification, <150ms median gen latency for 128-token requests
- Target pilot start: 2026-03-15; 4-week pilot; target decision date: 2026-04-12

Next steps I captured in the MAP: 
1) Velora: provide production sample traffic & security contacts (Emily / Rajiv) — due 2026-02-26
2) Redwood: environment provision + security questionnaire (Dev) — due 2026-03-05
3) Joint: pilot test window + weekly check-ins (Stef/Emily) — kickoff 2026-03-15

Please review the attached PDF and let me know any edits to milestones or owners. If everything looks good we can finalize and move the SOW to legal for signature.

Attachments: Velora_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@velorahealth.com>, Anya Kapoor <anya.kapoor@velorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (pilot success criteria & timeline)

Alex — thanks for the summary and the clear MAP. Quick clarifying notes after I shared with the product team: 

- Success criteria: can we add an additional quality metric — end-to-end NLU intent match >= 93% measured on a 500-sample validation set?
- Dependencies: our infra team needs a list of IP ranges and expected peak qps for the pilot (we can provide by end of day Tue)
- Legal: we prefer a single DocuSign round-trip (no redlines in the SOW) but may need standard NDA addendum.

We’ll review the milestones and propose one small timing shift: push the pilot start to 2026-03-17 (avoid vendor maintenance window). Otherwise the owners look correct. 

Attaching a short note with the infra questions — will confirm IP ranges tomorrow.

Thanks,
Emily Santos
Head of Product Operations | Velora Health
emily.santos@velorahealth.com

---
Attachment: velora_infra_questions.txt

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (pilot success criteria & timeline)

Emily — appreciate the quick review and the extra metric suggestion. I updated the MAP to include end-to-end NLU intent match >= 93% on a 500-sample set and adjusted the pilot kickoff to 2026-03-17. Changes are highlighted on page 2 of Velora_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf.

Dev — looking at infra questions from Velora, can you confirm the expected IP ranges and an estimate of peak qps for the pilot? We’ll need that to finalize the provision timeline.

Marissa — when we get agreement from Velora on the MAP I’ll need you to prepare the SOW using SOW_Template.docx and set up the DocuSign envelope. If legal requests the NDA addendum, please coordinate with their counsel (Emily cc’d).

Next milestones (updated):
- 2026-02-26: Velora to send sample traffic and IP ranges (Emily)
- 2026-03-05: Redwood completes security questionnaire, provision dev env (Dev)
- 2026-03-10: Redwood internal pre-check + dry-run (Alex/Dev)
- 2026-03-17: Pilot kickoff (joint)

Alex

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (pilot success criteria & timeline)

Thanks Alex / Emily. Quick tech readout: 

- IP ranges & endpoints: we’ll support a static egress range; providing CIDR list by 2026-02-27 EOD.
- Peak pilot QPS: estimate 120 qps sustained, 250 qps bursts (128-token average). If Velora expects higher we’ll need reserved capacity for the pilot window.
- Security questionnaire: filling and returning Velora_Security_Qs_filled.xlsx by 2026-03-05.

One ask: Velora, can you confirm whether PHI will be present in payloads for the pilot? If yes, we need to lock down encryption-at-rest details and confirm your DPO contact.

I’ll provision a dev cluster once we have sample traffic and final qps numbers.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@velorahealth.com>, Anya Kapoor <anya.kapoor@velorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (pilot success criteria & timeline)

All — quick update from our side: 

- IP ranges attached (see infra_answers.txt) and we do not expect PHI in pilot payloads — the pilot will use de-identified test data.
- Product has validated the 93% NLU target as acceptable for pilot evaluation.
- Legal is ready for DocuSign once Redwood sends the final SOW; they prefer a single signature (Velora signs last).

We reviewed the MAP and accept the milestones and owners as you outlined. Confirming target pilot kickoff date: 2026-03-17. Please send final MAP for sign-off and the SOW for signature routing.

Thanks,
Emily

Attachment: infra_answers.txt

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan — final sign-off and signature readiness

Emily — fantastic, thanks for the confirmations and the infra details. Per your note I’ve: 

- Incorporated the 93% NLU metric and pilot kickoff 2026-03-17 into the MAP (Velora_MAP_Draft_v3.pdf — final).
- Attached SOW_Template.docx populated with the pilot scope and pricing; Marissa will prepare DocuSign routing.
- Dev confirmed no PHI for pilot and provided CIDR list for provisioning.

Marissa — can you: 
1) Load the SOW into DocuSign with the following sign order: Redwood -> Velora (Velora signs last)
2) Include a short cover note summarizing success criteria and go-live target (we have pilot start 2026-03-17 and decision date 2026-04-12)

Emily / Rajiv — if the above looks correct please reply with a short sign-off ("MAP approved, ready for SOW") and we will route DocuSign this afternoon. Once signed we’ll provision production-like capacity for the pilot and confirm the go-live checklist items.

Looking forward to kickoff — Alex

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com
